svg.aria-label: What I build: AI Application Development — Products built on large language models, from internal assistants to customer-facing tools. AI Agent Development — Agents that plan multi-step tasks, call your tools and APIs, and hand off to a person when unsure. AI Workflow Automation — n8n and code workflows that connect AI steps to your forms, inboxes, CRMs and databases. LLM & RAG Integration — Retrieval-augmented generation over your documents, so answers stay grounded in your data. Web & Mobile Applications — Laravel, Node.js, Vue.js and React applications, plus the APIs behind mobile apps. Business Process Automation — Replacing manual data entry, reporting and hand-offs with processes you can monitor.
